How to play

Iron HorizonFive armies. One valley. No retreat.

Hold your four bases and your hidden hideout. Capture enemy bases with infantry, flatten them with missiles, and hunt down hideouts with drones and satellites.

You against four AI armies.
Five armies, every one for itself. Solo only.
